training_data.name: Nemotron 3.5 Content Safety Dataset
training_data.quote: The dataset combines real or previously collected/curated examples with synthetic and generated/augmented examples.

training_method.objective_quote: The fine-tuning used a supervised instruction-tuning setup.

source_claims.quote: BananaMind V2.5 Content Safety is a text-only content-safety classification model fine-tuned from google/gemma-4-E2B-it.

description.text: BananaMind V2.5 Content Safety is a text-only content-safety classification model fine-tuned from google/gemma-4-E2B-it. The model is designed to classify an input prompt as either Safe or Unsafe. For unsafe inputs, it also returns the violated safety categories.

output_type.quote: Model type: Instruction-tuned generative safety classifier

use_claim.quote: BananaMind V2.5 Content Safety is a text-only content-safety classification model fine-tuned from google/gemma-4-E2B-it.

warning.quote: This model is not intended to make legal, medical, emergency, employment, credit, law-enforcement, or other high-impact decisions.

serving.text_only_input_quote: text_to_classify = "I will punch you in the face and curse at you."
serving.system_prompt:
You are a strict content-safety classifier.

Classify the input as Safe or Unsafe.

Return exactly one of these formats:

Safe

or:

Unsafe
Violated Categories: <categories>
serving.notes: text_config.max_position_embeddings is 131072. Sliding attention uses sliding_window 512. The Hub safetensors total is 5104297539 BF16 parameters. The card does not state a parameter count. generation_config.json sets do_sample true, temperature 1.0, top_k 64, and top_p 0.95. The card example instead uses do_sample false and max_new_tokens 80. The example's classifier instructions are concatenated into the user message; chat_template.jinja writes a system turn only when a system or developer message is supplied, and it has no default system string. config.json still contains vision and audio configs from the Gemma 4 base. There is no adapter_config.json. The card says the adapter was merged. No GitHub repository and no paper were found. A sibling card, BananaMind/BananaMind-Content-Safety-Mini-1.5, reports an error rate for BananaMind V2.5 Content Safety E2B but does not print this repository id and describes a different base.

evaluation_reported.text: Overall error rate 5.12% on the test data. Peak cumulative error rate 10.0% early in the sweep, then about 5.0-5.1%. The same ordering gave ShieldGemma 2B 35.30%, ShieldGemma 9B 40.96%, and ShieldGemma 27B in 8-bit 52.46%.

discrepancies: Dataset and parent match the inventory. Inventory methods is empty. The card says the fine-tune was supervised instruction tuning and that a fine-tuned adapter was merged into the base weights. It does not name LoRA, QLoRA, rank, epochs, learning rate, or batch size.
